listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference cites an energy audit within the pulp and paper industry (Morocco) — appears only in reference list, not applied in this paper
listed_sector_signals.quote: Energy conservation potential of an energy audit within the pulp and paper industry in Morocco

one_line: The paper applies an ISO 50001/50002-based energy management and photovoltaic optimization methodology to a tertiary office building in Meknes, Morocco; the only continuous-industry reference (pulp & paper) is a citation, not an application.
